changelog: FIX: Parental Controls now actually hide locked categories. Previously the lock state was saved but never enforced — locked categories still showed up in Live TV, Movies, Series, and search. Now they are removed from the sidebar entirely AND their channels/movies/shows are filtered out of the 'All' and 'Favorites' buckets so the lock can't be bypassed by browsing 'All'.
To watch locked content, go to Settings → Parental Controls and toggle off the lock for that category.
